reason: Conversation 2 followed the expected process: isolate at the cooker switch (not the impractical 'unplug' advice in Conversation 1 for a hardwired built-in oven), cool, remove the cover and read the old bulb before buying, then gave a correct like-for-like E14 25W 300C recommendation with sensible fitting and escalation advice. Its main flaw was confidently asserting the model normally takes a G9 halogen, which is wrong for this oven and only rescued by the 'check the old bulb' hedge. Conversation 1 was efficient and got the bulb spec right first time (SES/E14 25W 300C) with a proper escalation path, but skipped the verification step and gave weaker isolation guidance, so it edges out only narrowly.
